verdict.rationale: Postmark documents dedicated Delivery and Bounce webhooks, a webhooks overview with security guidance (IP allowlisting, payload validation, signature/idempotency patterns), and general 'real-time event notifications' configuration — covering delivered and bounced outcomes well. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a Complaint/spam-complaint webhook, nor does it show documented retry behavior (retry counts, backoff, timeout policy) for webhook delivery. missing for 10: explicit complaint webhook documentation, documented retry/backoff policy for failed webhook deliveries, independent corroboration of retry behavior in practice.
